title: service_event
description: Service event that the KQL function ServiceEvents() derives from accepted live events. Read by the Activator service rule and the review-case writer. These events are independent of scoring (T05).

event_type.description: portal_fault_verified comes only from a software fault with fault_verified = true. A rejected or abandoned request is not a portal fault.

cycle_id.description: Mapped from the account context by event time.

evidence_ids.description: Source record IDs, for example the event_id, application_id, case_id or reversed entry_id. No notes.
